checkpointEvidence.reason: Align the pre-merge Contract gate with the staged release lifecycle: release verification evidence is collected by the explicit verify step, while the read-only hosted gate must not require a completion receipt before it executes.

intentAlignment.reason: The release Work Item binds the reviewed source and staged release policy while preserving post-release adopter evidence as an explicit boundary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: workspace package versions, lockfile, and current release documentation identify v0.2.60 while historical release facts remain unchanged
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run version consistency, metadata, documentation, and diff checks before publication

scenarioCoverage.expected: the reviewed PR passes all required hosted checks before the annotated release tag is created
scenarioCoverage.reason: hosted provider checks are external evidence collected on the reviewed PR before merge and bound by the finalization receipt
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: inspect the actual PR check conclusions and merge only after every required check passes

scenarioCoverage.expected: the public v0.2.60 release exposes archives, SHA256 checksums, SBOM, provenance, and a manifest bound to the release tag
scenarioCoverage.reason: public release assets are collected only after the reviewed source is merged and tagged
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: download only public release assets, verify checksum and manifest bindings, and retain the release receipt

scenarioCoverage.expected: a fresh adopter and N-1 upgrade pass from immutable downloaded artifacts with isolation, cleanup, and first-adopter-smoke not_ready proofs
scenarioCoverage.reason: public adopter evidence is collected only after the reviewed source is merged and tagged
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run the release adopter acceptance harnesses with isolated HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, TMPDIR, and CARGO_HOME and retain their receipts

scenarioCoverage.expected: the verified public v0.2.60 binary installed on this repository keeps inspect, status, doctor, Agent doctor, and documentation checks healthy
scenarioCoverage.reason: the published binary is installed only after the reviewed source is merged and tagged
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: install the checksum-verified public binary and run the repository-bound health and post-close checks
